biggest_catch: Boostlingo's official BPIN white paper is written for language-service-company buyers and shows example rates (e.g. Pashto judicial ≤$40/hr, Spanish medical ≤$45/hr) - these are rate-setting examples, not current official worker pay, and no payout timing is published.
catches: The ≤$40-50/hr figures are examples in a 2022 white paper aimed at buyers setting their own rates - not a current guaranteed worker pay statement.
No official payout timing: no payout schedule, processing time, or minimum is published.
Interpreters are typically added to Boostlingo by language-service companies as vendors, not hired as platform employees.
Rate examples carry 2+ year experience and certification requirements that not every interpreter meets.
